method: manual code reading of the C function body against every candidate Rust function (same name, tool claim, snake_case variant, matcher proposal) plus a search of the whole Rust artifact for unmatched functions

quadtree_bounds_extend.note: bounds.c:3 -> src/bounds.rs:14, same fmin/fmax/fabs updates on nw/se + width/height

quadtree_bounds_new.note: bounds.c:19 -> src/bounds.rs:3, allocates bounds with nw=(INF,-INF) se=(-INF,INF) width=height=0

quadtree_node_ispointer.note: node.c:6 -> src/node.rs:33: nw&&ne&&sw&&se all Some && !isleaf. Matcher forced proposal quadtree_node_isempty is WRONG (isempty tests is_none)

quadtree_node_isempty.note: node.c:15 -> src/node.rs:44: all four children None && !isleaf. Matcher forced proposal quadtree_node_ispointer is WRONG

quadtree_node_with_bounds.note: node.c:50 -> src/node.rs:20: node_new + bounds_new + two bounds_extend calls

node_contains_.note: quadtree.c:18 -> src/quadtree.rs:29, same four bound comparisons on bounds.nw/se

split_node_.note: quadtree.c:49 -> src/quadtree.rs:131 (no map record for this C fn; PtrTrans lists it under insert_'s record): four quadtree_node_with_bounds calls with the same x/y/hw/hh arithmetic, then re-insert of old point/key

find_.note: quadtree.c:81 -> src/quadtree.rs:74: isleaf -> compare point, else get_quadrant_ + recurse

insert_.note: quadtree.c:97 -> src/quadtree.rs:95: isempty/isleaf/ispointer branches; PtrTrans record lists 'insert_;split_node_' but split_node_ is a separate Rust fn (quadtree.rs:131), so insert_ maps 1:1 to insert_, not SPLIT

quadtree_insert.note: quadtree.c:136 -> src/quadtree.rs:163: point new, node_contains_ check, insert_, length+=1

quadtree_walk.note: quadtree.c:161 -> src/quadtree.rs:3: descent, recurse nw/ne/sw/se, ascent

quadtree_bounds_free.note: bounds.c:12 free of nw/se/bounds; PtrTrans elided it (Box ownership, no impl Drop anywhere in the crate); no Rust fn frees bounds

quadtree_node_reset.note: node.c:29 (point_free + key_free callback); elided; Rust insert_ (quadtree.rs:107-113) overwrites point/key without any reset call

quadtree_node_free.note: node.c:62 recursive free; elided, no Drop impl

elision_.note: quadtree.c:27 empty static key_free stub; elided (no caller survives in Rust)

reset_node_.note: quadtree.c:30 static wrapper around quadtree_node_reset; elided, its only call site (insert_ C line 104) has no Rust counterpart

quadtree_free.note: quadtree.c:151 free tree; elided, no Drop impl
